title: IBM Db2 Genius Hub 1.1.2, 1.1.3, 1.1.4, 1.1.5 improperly validates TLS certificate validation, which could allow an…
description: IBM Db2 Genius Hub versions 1.1.2 through 1.1.5 contain a vulnerability where TLS certificate validation is improperly implemented. This flaw could allow an attacker to perform a man-in-the-middle attack and obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.9.
